svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-shoulder-board-top-female-left","name":"Cadet officer shoulder board, left shoulder, top-down view (blank grade; rank_slot is the grade area)","size_in":{"w":4.75,"h":2.5},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,475,250],"size_source":"measured","size_basis":"Redrawn to the CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-6 proportions: 2.3 in wide (just over the 2 1/4 in three-diamond row), 4.55 in long (builder reference), 0.74 in peak, emblem and stripe colours from the Vanguard CAP0647V photo measurements; follows the figure over the photo.","anchors":{"top_center":[237.5,0],"bottom_center":[237.5,250],"center":[237.5,125],"left_edge":[0,125],"right_edge":[475,125],"board_center":[237.5,125],"rank_slot_center":[369.5,125],"board_outer_end":[465,125],"outer_end_center":[465,125],"button_end_center":[10,125],"board_top_left":[10,10]},"landmarks":{"board":{"x":10,"y":10,"w":455,"h":230},"rank_slot":{"x":302,"y":10,"w":135,"h":230},"rank_slot_frame":{"along_in":1.35,"across_in":2.3,"runs":"across the board (perpendicular to its length)","note":"the row of grade forms (Cadet Colonel: 3 diamonds 2 1/4 x 1 1/4 in) is centred on the blue band, CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-6; the board is 2.3 in wide so every grade fits at true size"}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); rank_slot is the stripe band at the outer end, below the emblem","overlay_of":"garment-blues-class-a-cadet-officer-insignia","dimensions":{"board_in":[4.55,1.843],"rank_slot_in":[1.35,2.3],"grade_form_max_in":[2.25,1.25]},"documented":["cadet officers wear regular-size grade insignia on Cadet Officer shoulder boards (CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2.1.3 / 4.1.9.3.4)"],"assumed":["stripe band centre 0.935 in from the outer end (from the board photo), grade slot 1.25 in along the board"],"fit":{"method":"measured from product photo","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
